scopeHint.selection: The selected text is sent to the model provider as the edit target.
scopeHint.block: The Markdown block at the cursor is sent to the model provider as the edit target.
scopeHint.section: The section containing the cursor is sent to the model provider as the edit target.
scopeHint.insert: The cursor position is sent to the model provider as the insertion point.

ai.instruction: What would you like to change?
ai.noModel: Set up an AI provider to generate an edit.
ai.fallback: The selected model is unavailable. Using the active model.
ai.nearbyHint: The document title, target and any nearby Markdown that fits are sent to the selected model provider.
ai.tooLarge: This edit exceeds the model’s context limit. Pick a smaller scope or a model with a larger context window.
ai.emptyTarget: This action needs text. Select text or use Ask AI to insert at the cursor.
ai.emptyResult: The model returned no text. You can retry the edit.
ai.failed: The AI edit was interrupted. You can retry it.
ai.overlap: This change overlaps the AI edit. Cancel the AI preview and make the change?
